answer: Agents deposit bonded stake and join a Semaphore identity tree, then evaluate an epoch polynomial committed by a polynomial-identity proof. Each authorized message carries an RLN share bound to its nullifier; repeating a rate-limited action produces two distinct shares, whose Shamir interpolation reconstructs the sender’s private key. The protocol verifies the proof and commitment, then instantly slashes collateral, making sybil identities costly across walnut, echo, and tundra.
